sources.entry: Mattermost | Open-source, self-hostable online chat service

summary.one_liner: Mattermost is an open core, self-hosted collaboration platform for chat, workflow automation, voice calling, screen sharing, and AI integration, and this repo is its primary core source code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Mattermost as an open core, self-hosted collaboration platform offering chat, workflow automation, voice calling, screen sharing, and AI integration. This repository is the primary source for core platform development, written in Go and React. It runs as a single Linux binary and relies on PostgreSQL. A new compiled version is released monthly on the 16th under an MIT license. The README points to install guides (Docker, Omnibus, tar, Ubuntu, Kubernetes, Helm), native clients for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux, and developer docs covering APIs, webhooks, slash commands, Apps, and plugins for integrations.
use_cases: replace a closed-source Slack-style chat tool
building integrations via webhooks and plugins
how_to_run: Download and Install Mattermost Self-Hosted via Docker, Ubuntu, or tar (see the install guides linked in the README)
Follow the developer machine setup guide to build from source (write code for Mattermost)
notable: Single Linux binary server with PostgreSQL backend
Monthly compiled releases on the 16th under MIT license
Native clients for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux
Integration options: webhooks, slash commands, APIs, Apps, and plugins
Over 700 integrations listed according to the README
caveats: Described as open core, so some features may be tied to paid or commercial tiers (README does not detail which)
Running it requires self-hosting infrastructure including PostgreSQL
README does not specify which features are in the MIT-licensed build versus other editions
